QuestInfo.2: You heard from #b#p9250134##k about the Demoralizing Aliens Project proposed by OSSS.

0.0: I see that you've been issued a Bing Machine-Alpha. The Bing Machine-Alpha can be continuously upgraded until it becomes  #b<Visitor Equipment>#k.
0.1: But to do that, you'll have to collect a lot of medals. Besides getting missions from #b#p9250133##k, the OSSS will provide other ways for you to get medals.

yes.0: For a more detailed explanation. Please talk to me again and ask about each subject.
